close_reason: false positive: Error enum already has #[non_exhaustive] at lib.rs:36
description: In pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs, the Error enum (line 36) is marked #[non_exhaustive] — good. However the crl_reason_name() match at line 171 is exhaustive over CrlReason variants. If x509-cert upstream adds a new CrlReason variant, crl_reason_name() will fail to compile. This is a maintenance hazard rather than a current bug, but worth noting for pre-merge review.
title: Missing #[non_exhaustive] on pkix-revocation Error enum — adding variants is a breaking change
